# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: jcabi-aspects 0.24.1 -> 0.25.1

## Context

Project `jcabi-simpledb` (by jcabi) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`com.jcabi:jcabi-aspects` from `0.24.1` to `0.25.1` (minor update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/jcabi/jcabi-simpledb/pull/155

## Your Task

The source code is in `/jcabi-simpledb`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.

## Steps

1. **Identify errors:**
   ```bash
   cd /jcabi-simpledb && mvn compile -B 2>&1 | grep -E "^\[ERROR\]" | head -60
   ```

2. **Understand breaking changes:** The new version `0.25.1` has API changes vs `0.24.1`.
   Review the failing source files and update calls to match the new API.
   - Old API sources: https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/com/jcabi/jcabi-aspects/0.24.1/jcabi-aspects-0.24.1-sources.jar
   - New API sources: https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/com/jcabi/jcabi-aspects/0.25.1/jcabi-aspects-0.25.1-sources.jar

3. **Apply fixes** to the Java source files in `/jcabi-simpledb`.

4. **Verify:**
   ```bash
   cd /jcabi-simpledb && mvn compile -B -q
   ```

## Success Criteria

`mvn compile` exits with **code 0** (no compilation errors).
